record.question: You are in a hurry to reach your office and jump a traffic light when it is red. The traffic policeman stops you and asks you to pay a fine (challan) of Rs.500. You would
options: Intimate the policeman that you are senior government servant who was in a hurry to go to office to attend an urgent meeting and therefore be excused.
Call a friend in the police department and ask him to request the policeman to spare you
Try to argue that the light was yellow when you crossed it and save yourself from fine, although you know that the light had turned red.
